name: ai-portals
description: Portals: an endless, hands-off flight through hundreds of generated worlds, each one reached through a portal in the last.

scripts.start:vr: test -f .cert/key.pem || (mkdir -p .cert && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 365 -subj /CN=portals-dev -keyout .cert/key.pem -out .cert/cert.pem) && HOST=0.0.0.0 TLS_CERT=.cert/cert.pem TLS_KEY=.cert/key.pem node tools/serve.mjs . 8444
